The `metrics_lambda.py` file defines a CDK construct for deploying a Lambda function that processes metrics events, along with associated resources like an SQS dead-letter queue, CloudWatch alarms, and an EventBridge event bus.

# Purpose
This Python code defines a construct for deploying a serverless application using the AWS Cloud Development Kit (CDK). The primary purpose of this file is to set up a Lambda function that processes metrics, along with the necessary infrastructure components such as an EventBridge event bus, a dead-letter queue (DLQ), and CloudWatch alarms for monitoring. The `MetricsLambda` class is a CDK construct that encapsulates the creation and configuration of these AWS resources. It uses various AWS services, including AWS Lambda for executing the function, AWS Secrets Manager for managing database credentials, AWS SSM for retrieving VPC information, and AWS CloudWatch for setting up alarms to monitor the health and performance of the Lambda function and the DLQ.

The code is structured to be part of a larger infrastructure-as-code setup, likely intended to be imported and used within a broader CDK application. It provides a focused functionality centered around metrics processing and monitoring, with configurable parameters for different environments such as development, staging, and production. The construct also includes logic to handle notifications via SNS when certain CloudWatch alarms are triggered, ensuring that operational issues can be promptly addressed. This file is not a standalone script but rather a component meant to be integrated into a larger CDK stack, providing a reusable and configurable way to deploy and manage a metrics processing pipeline in AWS.
